summary: Results-driven Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying high-performance web applications. Expertise in Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, React.js, Angular, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. Proficient in RESTful API design, database optimization (SQL/NoSQL), and version control using Git. Skilled in problem-solving, debugging, and delivering secure, scalable solutions in Agile/Scrum environments with strong communication skills.

description: Develop backend modules and REST APIs using Python (Frappe framework) for logistics and finance operations.
Worked with both SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases for efficient data storage and retrieval.
Implemented OAuth2 authentication and webhook integrations for QuickBooks Online.
Automated secure file transfers via SFTP and background job scheduling.
Collaborated in a remote Agile environment using Git-based workflows for version control.
Developed and maintained REST APIs using Python, Django, Django REST Framework.
Designed and implemented responsive UIs using React.js, Angular, TypeScript, Bootstrap, ensuring cross-device compatibility.
Optimized PostgreSQL database schemas and queries for performance improvements.
Implemented version control using Git/GitLab and participated in continuous integration workflows.
Followed Agile methodology with sprint planning and daily scrum.

projects.name: Logistics ERP Integration Platform
details: Developed a secure, high-performance ERP system for freight operations with automated booking workflows, EDI exchange, and a scalable data pipeline integrating Excel/CSV into database using ORM models.
Designed REST APIs for third-party logistics and accounting systems integration using Django REST practices.
Applied debugging and optimization for low-latency queries and high availability.
Integrated QuickBooks API securely with data validation and protection measures.

projects.name: Appraisal Management System
details: Built a performance evaluation platform with customizable appraisal forms and real-time visualization from SQL/ORM queries.
Integrated Angular frontend with DRF backend for smooth client-server interaction.
Optimized PostgreSQL indexes and queries for large-scale evaluations.
Implemented secure role-based access and robust error handling.

projects.name: Business Intelligence (BI) Software
details: Developed a BI system to analyze, transform, and report data for decision support via dashboards and KPIs.
Optimized ETL pipelines in Python with Pandas, storing transformed results into PostgreSQL using ORM.
Built REST APIs using DRF for secure interactive reporting and visualizations.

projects.name: Point of Sale (POS) System
details: Implemented POS system automating invoices, stock management, and accounting workflows with Django-MySQL backend.
Built secure DRF-based API endpoints with role-based authentication for external accounting integration.
Designed dashboards for real-time inventory and sales, enabling proactive decisions and fraud prevention.
